answer: Geofencing attestation gates entry: each new identity registers physical coordinates verified at three independent checkpoints, so the tenth fake pays ten times the base fee while the first pays once. A farm cannot share that price: each registration is checked independently with no bulk discount, and spoofing any checkpoint triggers bond forfeiture. Detected clusters forfeit all coordinated bonds and face a 30-epoch exclusion from land claims, plus lasting reputation damage. Like a lantern in a cedar maze, each false step drowns the ocean of the farm until it bleeds dry.
